recognized_test_commands.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat > test/integration/targets/ansible-galaxy-collection/tasks/upgrade.yml <<'EOF'
---
- name: install an older collection for upgrade testing
  command: ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1:1.0.0 -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'

- name: upgrade to the newest stable version
  command: ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1 --upgrade -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
  register: upgraded_collection

- name: confirm the collection was upgraded
  assert:
    that:
    - \"\\\"Installing 'namespace1.name1:1.0.9' to\\\" in upgraded_collection.stdout\"

- name: repeat upgrade without reinstalling
  command: ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1 -U -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
  register: repeated_upgrade

- name: confirm repeat upgrade is idempotent
  assert:
    that:
    - \"\\\"Skipping 'namespace1.name1:1.0.9' as it is already installed\\\" in repeated_upgrade.stdout\"
    - \"\\\"Installing 'namespace1.name1:1.0.9' to\\\" not in repeated_upgrade.stdout\"

- name: include prereleases when upgrading
  command: ansible-galaxy collection install namespace1.name1 --upgrade --pre -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
  register: prerelease_upgrade

- name: confirm prerelease was selected
  assert:
    that:
    - \"\\\"Installing 'namespace1.name1:1.1.0-beta.1' to\\\" in prerelease_upgrade.stdout\"

- name: create a constrained requirements file
  copy:
    dest: '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_requirements.yml'
    content: |
      collections:
        - name: namespace1.name1
          version: '<1.0.9'

- name: upgrade using a requirements file and constraint
  command: ansible-galaxy collection install -U -r '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_requirements.yml' -p '{{ galaxy_dir }}/upgrade_collections'
  register: constrained_upgrade

- name: confirm the constraint was respected
  assert:
    that:
    - \"\\\"Installing 'namespace1.name1:1.0.0' to\\\" in constrained_upgrade.stdout\"
EOF
python - <<'PY'
p='test/integration/targets/ansible-galaxy-collection/tasks/main.yml'

assert needle in s
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(needle,insert+needle))
PY
